propositions: When a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand or is demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph, a project-only advisory criterion should trigger a coaching move directing re-derivation with find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweep.
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring changes are required.

Project criterion ids cannot fire code-review moves because applies_when tags are drawn from a closed vocabulary (OVERLAY_IDS ∪ 'always'); the criterion must route to plan_review only, where criteria are drawn from surviving findings and can include project ids.

The criterion must be advisory via default_posture: 'advisory' with no blocking_enabled key, and must not compete with blocking built-ins (G1G2, G6, E4) that already catch incomplete inventories; detection is demonstrated live and move applicability is proven deterministically in tests.
Implementation follows the existing project.portability pattern across three overlay files with no changes to src/rebar/ shipped defaults.

Real runs demonstrate the criterion fires reliably on hand-enumerated inventories at validity 1.0, naming omitted files including string-literal monkeypatch sites that symbol graph tools cannot resolve.
